prompt.en: How high did unemployment reach in 1933, during the Great Depression?
prompt.fr: Quel sommet le chômage a-t-il atteint en 1933, pendant la Grande Dépression?

explanation.en: When the markets crashed in 1929, the long slump we call the Great Depression followed. By 1933 more than a quarter of workers — 27 per cent — had no job, and countless businesses closed for good.
explanation.fr: Après le krach des marchés de 1929 est venue la longue crise qu'on appelle la Grande Dépression. En 1933, plus du quart des travailleurs — 27 % — n'avaient pas d'emploi, et d'innombrables entreprises ont fermé pour de bon.

source.quote: Unemployment reached 27% in 1933 and many businesses were wiped out.

verification.evidence: The stock market crash of 1929, however, led to the Great Depression or the “Dirty Thirties.” Unemployment reached 27% in 1933 and many businesses were wiped out.
